title: [PM seat] domain:spec · seat 3 — 🟢 os-support-ai · 由 os-support-ai 账户的项目负责
body:
## Current PM

🟢 `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · seated 2026-10-27T00:29Z on the maintainer's summons in a project thread (「任务很多，你可以再开 spec 3 号座位」), a forced takeover from `baozhoutao` (see the audit comment below). `batch` 5 (the maintainer's words for every spec seat: 「并发都是5」). Dispatch back end: `mode:thread` for M+ / p1 / `security`, `mode:subagent` for S mechanical cards.

- **Previous holder:** `baozhoutao` · session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`, seated 2026-10-14T05:22Z, last own output `6308891165` (2026-10-21T05:35Z), no stand-down brief. It held no open card and no open PR at takeover (read: open issues/PRs with `assignee:baozhoutao`). Its full post (landed ledger, tails, lessons) is the previous body revision of this post; ⛔ not restated here.
- **Routine:** none (a session-made Routine carries no repo sources). Wake = the maintainer's project thread and PR subscriptions.
- **Body refreshed:** 2026-10-27T00:45Z.
- **Charter:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md`.
- **Lane split with seat 1 (#6017), agreed in the project:** this seat takes #26170, #26142, #26112, #26128 (the `area:i18n` cluster), #25923 and #25458. Seat 1 takes the rest of the `pm:queue` read at takeover. A card filed or freed later goes to the first claim under the normal protocol, after a re-read of the other seat's live `Claim:` comments and open-PR file lists.
- **Posture, round reports and ledger:** live in the project thread; per-card state lives on each card and PR.

## Handover ledger

Inherited by pointer: the previous body revision (the `baozhoutao` tenure). Its "waiting on the maintainer" items (#24668, #24669, #24677) are read on their own cards, not carried here.

## Hot-file serial queue

- **This seat holds:** nothing yet.
⛔ Re-derive from the live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's file list before every dispatch.
- **`merge=os-regen` paths** (`content/docs/references/**`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/**`) and the hand-kept registration files: merge with `bash scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`.
- **`.objectui-sha`:** the one `SINGLE_CLAIM_PATHS` entry.

## Notes

- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
- **Write channel:** the `fleet-write` relay (`dispatch`), read back on every write.
- **Tier:** a session below `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` runs every contract review it owes as an isolated at-tier subagent, ⛔ never in-seat.
